commands.name: call
commands.description: Run a [UcpFunction] static method by name, with its parameters from 'args'. Without 'name', list the functions on this host.
params: --name <string> function name; omit to list the functions on this host
--args <dictionary`2> the function's parameters, by parameter name

commands.name: help
commands.description: List every runtime command with its description and parameters
params: --command <string> one command by name or alias: its card, with an example call and the error codes
--format <string> [json|md] md: the cards as markdown in data.markdown
